mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies with a temperature of 70 degrees near Verona City Hall. The moon is in a waxing crescent phase, and if you look to the sky tonight at 8:23 PM, you can catch the International Space Station flying from the West Northwest near Cross Plains toward the Northeast near the Madison Home Depot for six minutes.

The Verona Police Department reported an incident on September 10th regarding a residential burglary on the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way. A 19-year-old male was arrested following reports of a gunshot, and he will face charges for burglary and recklessly endangering safety.

There is plenty to do in our community. Yoga is happening today at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Also, tomorrow features live music at Paddy Mac's and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park.
On September 10th, officers were dispatched to a residence on Hunter's Cove Way for a burglary in progress where a handgun was recovered, and no injuries were reported.
Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, but please note that the restaurant is currently closed for a remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available today.
